before.room.drowned_lantern.description: The inn is low and warm and smells of peat smoke and spilled ale. The {hearth|hearth} is big enough to stand in. {board|The rumor board} is thick with pinned notes, and {bar|Maud’s bar} runs along the back wall.
before.room.ferry_landing.description: Reeds crowd a slick wooden landing, and the river slides past it the color of strong tea. A {post|mooring post} leans into the current with a {notice|notice} nailed to it. {tide|Tide marks} stripe the pilings.
before.room.inn_attic.description: Dust lies thick as felt. {trunk|A trunk} with a broken hasp sits under the slope of the roof.
before.room.inn_rooms.description: A narrow passage of doors under the eaves. One stands open on {bed|a bed} made up tight, and {window|a window} over the green. {ceiling|The ceiling} sags a little at the end of the passage.
before.room.lantern_cellar.description: {casks|Ale casks} lie on their sides in cradles. The floor is gritty, and the air tastes of old beer. {holes|Rat holes} gnaw the base of every wall.
before.room.well_lane.description: A cobbled lane climbs from the landing toward the green. In the middle stands {well|the well}, with a {bucket|bucket} on a chain, and {steps|worn steps} going down inside the shaft. The chandler’s door is west; the Drowned Lantern’s sign creaks to the east.
before.item.lantern.room: A [brass lantern] sits on a coil of rope.
before.item.lantern.description: Dented brass with a horn window, oil sloshing inside. WREN is scratched on the base in a child’s capitals.
before.npc.bram.room: Old Bram the ferryman stands here, one boot on the ferry.
before.dialogue.bram_offer.prompt: Bram keeps his eyes on the reeds. "My lantern's out at the shelter past the reed bank, and I can't leave the ferry. The search party won't go out without it."

prepared_previous_draft.room.inn_attic.description: Dust lies thick as felt. A trunk with a locked hasp sits under the slope of the roof.

alignment_before.dialogue.bram.prompt: Bram looks at the lantern, then at the reeds. "Are you coming with us, or do you mean to go along the bank yourself?"
alignment_before.dialogue.bram.leave: Leave it with the search party
alignment_before.narration.bram.carry: You keep the lantern. Bram nods once and points you down the bank.
alignment_before.narration.bram.leave: You hand Bram the lantern. He lifts it toward the reeds and calls the others in.
alignment_before.dialogue.bram_offer.prompt: Bram keeps his eyes on the reeds. "My lantern’s beside the well, and I can’t leave the ferry. The search party won’t go out without it."
alignment_before.quest.lantern.carried: You carry the lantern for the search party.
